findingsSummary.headline: REQ-008 (queryLivePositions + real restart + fresh evidence) is entirely unimplemented -- the real Bug 1 this feature exists to fix is still live in production, only detected, not corrected.

runConfigDriftDetector silently drops a target from registryDrift entirely (no unobservable FAIL, no anything) when its ANICCA_HOME token is missing -- a direct, untested violation of REQ-010's own 'never silently exclude from targets' edge case and REQ-004 fail-closed (config-drift.mjs:413-417).

The iteration-2 fix that makes an OBSERVED-but-key-absent env fall back to codeDefault (to stop spurious Franklin/com.anicca.daemon false positives) opens a real false-negative: it cannot see an ANICCA_BRAIN override sourced from $ANICCA_HOME/.env (a real, already-supported config.mjs precedence layer that never reaches ps's OS-level env), so a real drift through that channel would be silently reported as PASS.
